title: Addressing the Programme manager
description: How to write for a reader acting as Programme manager. One rule, moved out of the role's own `voice` field (#1168): a voice points at the role it addresses, so the role names no voice and a second voice for the same reader is added without editing the role.

sources.title: Role `programme-manager` — its persona, in the cat-harness role graph

rules.title: Status first, computed values only
rules.description: Status first, computed values only. Mark what is measured and leave judgements blank rather than guessing.

source.quote: Tracking delivery across several workstreams. Needs state and trend, not detail. Will plan against any number shown, so an invented estimate is worse than a blank.
